sources.entry: OpenIn - Take control of installed apps on your Mac [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/openin-4-advanced-link-handler/id1643649331?platform=mac)

summary.name: OpenIn
summary.one_liner: OpenIn is a macOS utility that routes URLs, mail links, phone links, and files to the application you choose, using rules and optional scripts.
use_cases: Send links to different browsers or profiles depending on the domain
Open mailto links in a webmail provider such as Gmail or Outlook
Open Zoom invitations directly in the Zoom app
Route links based on the active macOS Focus
Choose an application for a file type with a picker dialog
Open links in a private browser window
summary.what_it_does: OpenIn routes URLs, mailto and tel links, and files to a target application. Each handler (Browsers, Mail, Tel, or a file type) has an ordered list of rules that narrow the available targets; if one target remains it opens directly, otherwise a picker appears. Rules can match domains, paths, modifier keys, source app, Focus Hint, or Share Menu and Handoff requests. Targets can have regex URL rewriting, browser profile or private mode settings, and custom zsh scripts or JavaScript that can modify URLs. The browser extensions for Safari, Chrome and Firefox send links to OpenIn via the context menu or toolbar button.
notable: Rule-based routing with JavaScript rule and default-handler scripts that can inspect the request and source app
Regex URL rewriting and zsh script targets
Browser profile and private window support where the browser allows external launch
Distributed via Mac App Store (needs OpenIn Helper), direct web download, and Setapp
caveats: The trial version always shows the application selection dialog
App Store version is sandboxed and needs OpenIn Helper for some features; licenses do not transfer between App Store and direct versions
Profile selection only works in browsers that offer an external launch mechanism; some browsers such as Arc or Dia may not be supported
